theater: 色雷斯腹地與保加利亞戰線

battle.name: 小巴達斯·福卡斯的叛亂
battle.theater: 色雷斯腹地與保加利亞戰線
battle.brief: 公元987年春，拜占庭皇帝約翰一世·齊米斯克斯征保加利亞，名將小巴爾達斯·福卡斯在色雷斯舉兵叛變，帝國野戰骨幹分裂。福卡斯死於伏擊，叛亂旋即瓦解；齊米斯克斯親統大軍，八月於阿凱洛俄斯擊敗西米恩，十月攻陷普雷斯拉夫。卡面亞述長矛遠早此役，短柄長刃鐵鏃正是拜占庭步兵長矛的祖型。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 交戰雙方其實同屬拜占庭帝國，這是一場內戰式的叛亂，而非國與國之間的戰爭。皇權一方是皇帝約翰一世·齊米斯克斯（969—976年在位）所代表的中央：御前侍從與禁軍（Akindynos）、元老貴族議會（Senate）、財政與稅賦機構，以及色雷斯、馬其頓等軍區（themata）的守軍與前線部隊。叛變一方是福卡斯軍事貴族集團，核心人物小巴爾達斯·福卡斯官至「宮內軍長官」（domestikos tōn scholōn，即帝國野戰軍總司令），他身邊是一批在安納托利亞東部戰線與愛琴海沿岸隨他作戰多年、由他一手提拔與分派的將官、侍從與私兵。外圍的第三方是保加利亞第一帝國及其沙皇西米恩一世，以及居住在多瑙河下游草原的佩切涅格與庫曼部眾。拜占庭的野戰軍以軍區徵召的步兵為骨幹，騎兵由披重甲的「卡塔弗拉克托斯」（kataphraktoi）與「庫隆突利翁」（kylindoi）之類部隊組成，後勤依賴軍糧輸送線與沿途徵發的糧食。一場叛亂之所以致命，正因為它發生在大軍集結、糧秣正在流動的時刻，而叛變者本人掌握著其中最能打的那一部分。
countriesEn: The two sides of this conflict belonged to the same state: the Byzantine Empire. It was a civil war in the form of a revolt, not a war between two countries. The imperial side was the centre represented by Emperor John I Tzimiskes (r. 969-976): the eunuch guard and household troops (Akindynos), the Senate of noble families, the fiscal and tax apparatus, and the garrisons and frontier detachments of the themes of Thrace and Macedonia. The rebel side was the Phokas military aristocracy, centred on Bardas Phokas the Younger, who held the office of Domestic of the Schools (domestikos ton scholon), commander-in-chief of the field army, and who had around him a group of officers, squires and private retainers raised and distributed by himself over years of campaigning in the eastern Anatolian and Aegean theatre. The third party surrounding the affair was the First Bulgarian Empire under Tsar Simeon I, together with the Pecheneg and Cuman peoples of the lower Danube steppe. The Byzantine field army rested on infantry levied from the themes, with cavalry supplied by units such as the fully armoured kataphraktoi and the kylindoi, and it depended on the grain convoys and on food requisitioned along the line of march. A revolt is deadly precisely because it breaks out at the moment when the army is assembled and the grain is already moving, and because the rebel himself commands the most formidable part of that force.
people: 關鍵人物多在福卡斯家族內部。叛變主角小巴爾達斯·福卡斯是次子：父老巴爾達斯·福卡斯是君士坦丁七世與羅曼諾斯二世時期的東方軍統帥，963年出任「宮內總管」（parakoimomenos），一度是帝國實際掌權者，約975/976年去世；長兄尼基弗羅斯二世·福卡斯963—969年在位，東征阿拉伯、攻陷阿勒頗與大馬士革，把帝國推向頂峰。約翰一世·齊米斯克斯是羅曼諾斯一世出身的亞拉曼尼亞軍人，帝國正是在他與福卡斯家族的角力中才安定下來。小巴爾達斯·福卡斯965年前後任安納托利亞軍區將領，970—971年兩度圖謀推翻約翰一世而失敗，被流放至黑海北岸的赫爾松；其後獲赦召回，約980/981年出任野戰軍總司令，成為帝國最令人生畏的戰將之一。他死後，叔父小利奧·福卡斯於985/986年出任宮內總管，延續福卡斯家的權勢，卻於989年前後被殺，家族自此退出權力核心。保加利亞方面，沙皇西米恩一世多年發動跨境攻勢；其子 Boris II於987年8月20日阿凱洛俄斯之戰被俘，至996年死於囚禁。記錄本役的主要史料是《狄奧菲尼斯續編》與《約翰·西爾利茲編年史》，兩書對叛變的經過說法不一。
peopleEn: Most of the key figures belong to the Phokas family. The rebel leader, Bardas Phokas the Younger, was the second son: his father, Bardas Phokas the Elder, commanded the eastern armies under Constantine VII and Romanos II, became parakoimomenos in 963 and for a time was the de facto ruler of the empire, and died around 975/976; his elder brother, Nikephoros II Phokas, reigned from 963 to 969, waging war against the Arabs, taking Aleppo and Damascus, and pushing the empire to its height. John I Tzimiskes was an Armenian soldier risen under Romanos I, and the empire only settled down through his struggle with the Phokas clan. Bardas Phokas the Younger was commander of the Anatolian theme around 965, twice plotted to overthrow John I in 970-971 and failed, and was exiled to Cherson on the northern shore of the Black Sea; later pardoned and recalled, he became Domestic of the Schools around 980/981 and became one of the most feared commanders in the empire. After his death his uncle Leo Phokas the Younger took the office of parakoimomenos in 985/986, carried on the family ascendancy, and was killed around 989, after which the clan left the centre of power. On the Bulgarian side, Tsar Simeon I had launched repeated raids across the frontier for years; his son Boris II was captured at the Battle of Achelous on 20 August 987 and remained a prisoner until his death in 996. The principal sources for this affair are the Continuation of Theophanes and the Chronicle of John Skylitzes, and the two do not agree on how the revolt unfolded.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛，是短柄、長刃、配鐵鏃的近東式刺擊長矛，本質上屬於亞述以來那套「以矛為骨幹的密集步兵」裝備：矛不單是刺擊兵器，更是把盾牆固定成一面拒馬的支架。時隔一千八百年，它在拜占庭體系裡的對應物並非任何單一「同型槍」，而是兩個族群：一是步兵手中那類樸素的短柄長刃矛（akontion），二是重騎兵的長矛（kontos）——後者以長杆配鐵鏃，同樣靠刺穿鎧甲與軟甲的接縫取效，與卡面長矛的殺傷邏輯完全一致。與之配套的還有拜占庭的圓盾（skouton）、縱列鱗甲（klivanion）與青銅盔、步兵的短劍（paramerion）與匕首（kinak）、弓手使用的複合弓與箭、軍隊的皮帳與炊具，以及攻城用的撞槌與雲梯；987年普雷斯拉夫陷落時，帝軍還以塔樓與攻城器強攻城牆。福卡斯本人最倚賴的是騎兵、矛兵與弓箭手之間的配合：矛兵以盾牆把重騎送出陣地，弓手與投石手在兩翼削弱敵陣，而短柄長刃矛正是一名帝國步卒在列陣時握在手裡的那件不起眼的傢伙。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card is a Near Eastern thrusting spear with a short shaft, a long blade and an iron head. It belongs essentially to the Assyrian tradition of massed infantry in which the spear did double duty: it was a stabbing weapon and, at the same time, the prop that locked a shield wall into a single wall of resistance. Some eighteen centuries later, its counterpart in the Byzantine order was not any single identical weapon but two families: the plain short-hafted spear (akontion) carried by infantry, and the long kontos of the heavy cavalry, a long-shafted, iron-headed lance that worked by the same logic, running through the seams of armour and mail. Alongside them stood the round shield (skouton), the lamellar scale corselet (klivanion) and the bronze helmet, the infantryman's short sword (paramerion) and knife (kinak), the composite bow and arrows of the archers, the leather tents and cooking kit of the camp, and the rams and ladders of the siege train; when Preslav fell in 987, the imperial army forced its walls with towers and siege engines. What Phokas himself relied on above all was the cooperation of cavalry, spear and bow: spearmen braced in the shield wall to launch the heavy horse, archers and slingers worked the flanks to thin the enemy line, and the short-hafted, long-bladed spear was the humble tool an imperial footman held while standing in the ranks.
tactics: 色雷斯戰線的地面以山嶺、森林與多瑙河至愛琴海之間的河谷縱橫，適合設伏與斷後，是佩切涅格、庫曼與保加利亞騎兵慣用的活動地形。福卡斯一方的部署沿用拜占庭野戰軍的常規：步兵以軍區徵召的方陣列陣，重裝騎兵（kataphraktoi）列於兩翼或前鋒，弓手與投石手居中或側後，輕騎（proikoi）負責偵察與追擊。叛變被揭發之後，平叛本身就是一場以速度取勝的追擊戰：齊米斯克斯集中兵力切斷福卡斯所部與保加利亞軍的聯繫，並用草原輕騎封鎖色雷斯的山口與渡口，使叛軍失去外援與補給。福卡斯陣亡後，齊米斯克斯改為親自統一指揮，於987年8月20日阿凱洛俄斯之戰中以重騎迂迴正面、包抄保加利亞軍的側翼，迫使西米恩的軍隊潰散，Boris II被生擒；同年10月13日，帝軍以撞槌與雲梯強攻普雷斯拉夫，奪取保加利亞的都城與國庫。從制度上看，叛亂能否成功，取決於叛者能否控制君士坦丁堡的禁軍與馬術校場（Hippokourion）這兩個兵變節點，以及能否贏得安納托利亞軍區的支持。
tacticsEn: The ground of the Thracian front is cut by mountains, woods and the valleys running from the Danube to the Aegean, and it is terrain well suited to ambush and to cutting an enemy off, the kind of country the Pecheneg, Cuman and Bulgarian horsemen habitually used. Phokas's side followed the standard deployment of the Byzantine field army: infantry drawn from the themes formed up in phalanx, the heavily armoured kataphraktoi were posted on the flanks or in front, archers and slingers in the centre or behind them, and light horse (proikoi) tasked with reconnaissance and pursuit. Once the revolt came to light, suppressing it became a pursuit fought on speed: Tzimiskes concentrated his strength to cut Bardas's detachment off from the Bulgarian army and used the steppe light horse to seal the passes and fords of Thrace, denying the rebels foreign help and supplies. After Phokas was killed Tzimiskes took personal command. At the Battle of Achelous on 20 August 987 he wheeled the heavy cavalry round the front of the Bulgarian line, fell upon its flanks and broke the army of Simeon, taking Boris II prisoner; on 13 October the same year the imperial army assaulted Preslav with rams and ladders and seized the Bulgarian capital and its treasury. At the level of institutions, the fate of such a revolt depended on whether the rebel could seize the eunuch guard and the Hippokourion, the two nodes of the capital where coups were made, and whether he could win the Anatolian themes to his side.
data: 可核對的數字並不多。時間線上，約翰一世第一次大規模進攻保加利亞在986年，第二次在987年，本役屬第二次，叛變起於此次出征期間。8月20日（公元987年），帝軍於阿凱洛俄斯擊敗保加利亞軍；10月13日，普雷斯拉夫陷落。Boris II自阿凱洛俄斯被俘，至996年死於囚禁，先後約九年。福卡斯的流放地赫爾松在黑海北岸的克里米亞，與君士坦丁堡之間隔著整片黑海北岸草原地帶，押解與流放走海路轉陸路，耗時以月計而非以日計。帝國野戰軍的規模，編年史多以「數萬」「無數」形容，沒有留下可供核算的兵員數；福卡斯本人所率分隊的具體人數、他叛變時掌握的騎兵數量、以及雙方傷亡數，史料完全沒有記載，可以確定的只是這是一場足以動搖半個帝國的內亂。作戰後勤方面，編年史提到帝軍在色雷斯就地徵發糧草，並在突擊中奪取保加利亞營地內的積存，說明一支大軍深入敵境時對就地補給的依賴。戰後帝國自保加利亞國庫取得大量戰利品與金銀鑄幣，成為巴西爾二世早年財政的基礎之一。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers are few. On the timeline, John I's first large invasion of Bulgaria came in 986 and his second in 987; this affair belongs to the second, and the revolt began during that expedition. On 20 August 987 the imperial army broke the Bulgarian force at Achelous, and on 13 October Preslav fell. Boris II, captured at Achelous, remained a prisoner until his death in 996, some nine years later. Cherson, the place of Phokas's exile, lay on the Crimean shore of the Black Sea, and the whole northern steppe of the sea lay between it and Constantinople, so that the escort and the journey were measured in months rather than days. The size of the imperial field army is described by the chroniclers only as tens of thousands or countless, and no figure exists that can be checked; there is no record at all of the strength of the detachment Phokas commanded, of the number of cavalry he held when he rebelled, or of casualties on either side, and the only certain statement is that this was a mutiny large enough to shake half the empire. On logistics, the chroniclers record the imperial army requisitioning grain on the spot in Thrace and seizing the stores of the Bulgarian camp in a sudden attack, which shows how dependent a great army operating deep inside enemy country was on local supply. After the war the empire took large quantities of booty and of gold and silver coin from the Bulgarian treasury, which became one of the foundations of Basil II's early finances.
cause: 起因有遠因也有近因。遠因是福卡斯家族在十世紀中葉對帝國的絕對壟斷：老巴爾達斯·福卡斯任宮內總管，長子尼基弗羅斯二世於963年以宮廷政變奪位，東征把拜占庭推向頂峰，帝國的軍功、封賞與任官幾乎全由這個家族分派；953年的宗教改革與960年代的戰事同樣出自福卡斯家的推動。次子小巴爾達斯·福卡斯原本是與兄長並肩的前線統帥，卻始終只是「小」的那一個：兄長為皇帝，自己為將；兄長969年遇刺後，亞拉曼尼亞出身的約翰一世登基，這位皇帝不屬於福卡斯圈，卻要靠福卡斯家的軍力支撐。970—971年小巴爾達斯兩次密謀反對約翰一世而失敗，遭到流放，這段屈辱成了他日後的積怨。980/981年他獲赦復職，出任野戰軍總司令，隨即在986、987年兩次對保加利亞的大戰中扮演主角；戰功越大，威望越高，皇帝與他之間的政治距離也就越近。近因則是987年出征途中福卡斯所部在色雷斯的異動被察覺，帝軍隨即以軍事手段平叛，編年史對觸發經過各有說法。
causeEn: The causes are both remote and immediate. The remote cause is the near absolute dominance of the Phokas family over the empire in the middle of the tenth century: Bardas Phokas the Elder as parakoimomenos, and his elder son Nikephoros II, who seized the throne in 963 by a court coup, whose eastern wars brought Byzantium to its height, and through whom the empire's commands, rewards and appointments were almost all distributed; the religious reforms of 953 and the wars of the 960s were likewise pushed by this family. Bardas Phokas the Younger was by nature a front-line commander standing shoulder to shoulder with his brother, yet he remained for ever only the younger one: his brother was emperor and he was a general; and when the brother was murdered in 969, John I, an Armenian of humble origin, took the throne. That emperor did not belong to the Phokas circle, yet his rule rested on the family's military power. Twice in 970-971 Bardas the Younger plotted against John I and failed, and the exile that followed was the humiliation on which his later grievance was built. Pardoned and restored around 980/981, he became Domestic of the Schools and then took the leading part in the two great campaigns against Bulgaria in 986 and 987; the greater his war record, the higher his prestige, and the closer the political distance between himself and the emperor became. The immediate cause is the detection, during the expedition of 987, of strange movements by Phokas's troops in Thrace, whereupon the imperial army settled the matter by force, the chronicles differing over how the crisis was triggered.
impact: 影響分三層。帝國層面，拜占庭最精銳的野戰指揮官之一死於自己人的叛亂，雖然叛事數月而平，代價卻已付出；同年普雷斯拉夫陷落，把西米恩一世經營數十年的聲望打得粉碎，保加利亞此後二十餘年無力再向色雷斯深處推進，帝國因此得到喘息之機。權力結構層面，福卡斯家並未因小巴爾達斯之死而失勢，叔父小利奧·福卡斯以宮內總管的身份延續了這個家族在巴西爾二世即位初年的權力，直到989年前後被殺，其餘成員相繼被貶黜或流放；此後巴西爾二世把兵權收歸御前，帝國才真正進入親政期，保加利亞的殘弱又讓帝國得以在1014年完成北線征服。對外關係層面，沙皇西米恩一世在阿凱洛俄斯失去幼子與都城，其與羅馬教廷及西歐的聯繫亦受牽動，帝國趁這段空窗整頓安納托利亞。
impactEn: The consequences work on three levels. At the level of the empire, one of the finest field commanders in Byzantium was killed in a revolt of his own men, and although the rising was settled within months the price had already been paid; in the same year the fall of Preslav shattered the standing that Simeon I had built over two decades, Bulgaria was unable for more than another twenty years to push deep into Thrace, and the empire gained room to breathe. At the level of the power structure, the Phokas clan did not fall with the death of Bardas the Younger: his uncle Leo Phokas carried the family ascendancy forward as parakoimomenos through the first years of Basil II's reign, until he was killed around 989 and the remaining members were demoted or exiled in turn; only after that did Basil II draw the army back into his own hands and the empire enter a period of personal rule, and the enfeebled Bulgarian state allowed the empire to complete its northern conquest in 1014. At the level of foreign relations, Tsar Simeon I lost his younger son and his capital at Achelous, his ties with the Roman curia and the West were also disturbed, and the empire used the resulting lull to reorganise Anatolia.
result: 結果是叛亂失敗。福卡斯的兵眾在色雷斯被帝軍切斷與外國的聯繫，旗幟在數月之內瓦解；小巴爾達斯·福卡斯本人於987年出征途中在伏擊中身亡，編年史或稱他為保加利亞人所殺、或稱他被自己人所除，說法不一，唯一確定的是他沒有再回到君士坦丁堡。齊米斯克斯隨即親領大軍，8月20日於阿凱洛俄斯大破西米恩的軍隊並生擒 Boris II，10月13日攻陷普雷斯拉夫，取得保加利亞的國庫與大批戰利品；988/989年他凱旋而歸，卻在返程中於 Chalcedon 遇刺身亡，由巴西爾二世與康士坦丁八世共治。福卡斯家因此輸掉了最後一位能打的統帥，一個在960年代為帝國開疆拓土的軍事家族退回宮廷權力鬥爭之中，直至989年被清剿殆盡。帝國北線壓力驟減，保加利亞一蹶不振，直到1014年巴西爾二世才最終完成對它的征服。
resultEn: The revolt failed. Bardas's men were cut off in Thrace from contact with any foreign power, and his banners came down within a few months; Bardas Phokas the Younger himself was killed in an ambush on the march in 987. The chroniclers variously say he was killed by Bulgarians or removed by his own men, and they do not agree; the only certain fact is that he never returned to Constantinople. Tzimiskes took command in person, destroyed Simeon's army at Achelous on 20 August and took Boris II prisoner, stormed Preslav on 13 October and came away with the Bulgarian treasury and a great deal of booty; in 988/989 he made his triumphal return, only to be murdered at Chalcedon on the way, after which Basil II and Constantine VIII ruled together. In this way the Phokas family lost the last of its able commanders, and a military clan that had carried the empire to its widest extent in the 960s fell back into palace struggle until it was swept away around 989. Pressure on the northern frontier eased, Bulgaria declined to the point of collapse, and it was not until 1014 that Basil II completed the conquest of it.
